question: What the 2.010 supplies too many is that a country keeps at every start beside the start saves, and why the energy conversion and the lent divisions leave the stockpiles out

addresses.name: CUnit::CarrySupplies
addresses.signature: void __stdcall CUnit::CarrySupplies(CUnit* unit, CMapProvince* province, bool parachuted, bool fromStockpile)
addresses.comment: **What a unit brings with it into a province**: SUPPLYPOOL_DAYS - PARASUPPLYPOOL_DAYS where `parachuted` - of what it uses in supplies and in fuel, as far as the source has them, moved into the province's pool. The source is its owner's stockpile (GetPool: pool_in_exile for a government in exile, else the acting capital's pool); but the pool of the unit's previous province (+0x134) where it has one and that is land; and for a unit with none, where `fromStockpile` is clear and the game is under way (CCurrentGameState +0xDA4, in_game): **the stockpile where the province's owner (+0x330, owner_id) is the unit's owner (+0x128), whoever holds it; nothing where neither its owner nor its controller (+0x338) is; and where the unit's owner holds ground another owns, the pool of the province's depot (+0x48), nothing where it has none** - corrected 2026-11-15 off the listing, this said the depot was taken on ground the owner owns and another holds. Five callers: CUnit::EnterProvince (0x5BF313) for a land unit aboard nothing entering a land province other than its own, before current_province_ptr is changed; RemoveFromTransport (0x5CF1B8) and CNavy::UnloadCarried (0x5CFEC2) for units put ashore; CAir::ReleaseCarried (0x5D09F8) with the parachute byte; and RunSupplyAndConvoyIterations (0x6790D7) for every unit the filling left with nothing. So a marching army takes its days of supplies out of the province it leaves, and **every land unit put in a province from nowhere brings its days** - placed by CUnitDeployment::DeployAt, made by CCreateNewHQCommand::Execute, CCreateHigherCommand::Execute or CreateRebelsForFaction, each of which enters the unit through CUnit::EnterProvince while its current province is still null: out of the stockpile on its owner's own ground, and with no commander's reach in what it uses, the unit being nowhere when SupplyConsumption is asked. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-supplypass.md, section 5, and FINDINGS-laterstart.md, section 17.
addresses.revises: comment only: the in-game source of a unit with no previous province corrected (owner tested first - its own ground pays from the stockpile whoever holds it, ground it holds and another owns from the depot); adds that every land unit put in a province from nowhere carries
addresses.evidence: Disassembled VA 0x5BED80..0x5BEFB8 (scripts/disasm.py): +0x134 null -> `cmp byte [ebp+0x14], 0; jne 0x5BEEAD` (fromStockpile: the stockpile kept in [ebp-0x10]); `cmp byte [esi+0xDA4], 0; je 0x5BEEAD` (not in game: the stockpile); `cmp [ecx+0x330], eax(=[edi+0x128]); je 0x5BEEAD` (owner_id is the unit's owner: the stockpile); `cmp [ecx+0x338], eax; jne 0x5BEFB8` (controller not the unit's owner: out, nothing moved); `mov eax,[ecx+0x48]; cmp eax,0; jle 0x5BEFB8`; `mov eax,[[esi+0xB8C]+eax*4]; add eax,0x15C` (the depot's pool). +0x330 and +0x338 are CMapProvince owner_id and controller_id in project.json. Measured in OpenHOI3: a new headquarters carries 2.010 out of the stockpile into its province (Ireland's Limerick holds 3.624 supplies in Germany1936_01_01_00 where the new game held 1.614 and Dublin 2.010 more). Would be shown wrong by a unit placed on its own ground held by an enemy drawing on the enemy's depot.

addresses.name: CUnit::EnterProvince
addresses.comment: **Puts a unit into a province**: it writes `current_province_ptr` (+0x130) at 0x1BF4D3, after taking the unit's counter out of the old province's stack and before putting it in the new one's. It refreshes the unit's intel level (+0x1F8) and marks the avatar stale where that or land-and-sea changed, and then places the avatar: at the province's point +0xCC for a land or sea unit with no path, +0xD8 for one with a path, +0xFC for an air unit, and for a fleet in a land province or a wing at its own base at the port or the unit point less the label point. A fleet entering takes what it carries with it, and puts ashore and checks for combat what it carries into a land province at the end of its path. For a selected unit with a path the arrow is made again. **Before current_province_ptr is written** (VA 0x5BF2A1..0x5BF313): where the province is not the one the unit is in, the province is land (template +0x22), the unit is land (slot 15) and aboard nothing (its army's carried_by +0x300 and plane +0x304 both null), CUnit::CarrySupplies(unit, province, 0, 0) - so a unit new to the map, whose current province is null, brings SUPPLYPOOL_DAYS of what it uses out of its owner's stockpile (read 2026-11-15, FINDINGS-laterstart.md section 17). Logs 'is located in illegal province 0!' (unit.cpp). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-movement.md.
addresses.revises: comment only: adds the CarrySupplies gate and that a unit new to the map carries its days from the stockpile
addresses.evidence: Disassembled VA 0x5BF2A1..0x5BF318: `cmp [ebx+0x130], esi; je 0x5BF4C9`; `mov eax,[esi+0xD4]; cmp byte [eax+0x22],0; je 0x5BF318`; `call [vtbl+0x3C]; test al,al; je 0x5BF318`; `call [vtbl+0x24]; cmp [eax+0x300],0; jne`; `call [vtbl+0x24]; cmp [eax+0x304],0; jne`; `push 0; push 0; push esi; push ebx; call 0x5BED80`. Its callers CCreateNewHQCommand::Execute (0x5E0F97, then 0x5E0FAC), CCreateHigherCommand::Execute (0x5DFBE8) and CreateRebelsForFaction (0x4BAE8A, then 0x4BAE9F) are among the 62 direct calls scripts/findRefs.py lists. Would be shown wrong by a new headquarters that brought nothing - the start saves' stockpiles say it brings 2.010.

addresses.name: UpdateIC_EnergyToCrudeOil
addresses.comment: **Energy into crude oil, read through.** rva 0xF0FF5..0xF13E2 of CCountry::UpdateIC, the country in ebx, run only with applyDailyEffects. All thousandths. need = TotalIC * 2000; spare = pool.energy - need; most = max(TotalIC * 1000 * 1000 / 20000, 1000), so 0.05 an IC and at least 1. Skipped when spare <= 0. energyNet and crudeNet are the day's income less expense so far for each good, summed off the same fifteen CGoodsPools one slot apart (income: home, convoyed_in, traded_for, +0x848, conversion_made, +0x8FC, back, +0xA64; expense: to, usage, conversion_used, convoyed_out, traded_away, less +0x824 and +0x920). **What the pools hold at that moment** (read 2026-11-15): usage - with sent_to, sent_back, tribute_received and received_from_exiles - was zeroed at the head of the day by CCountry::ClearDailyPools, before the supply pass; conversion_made and conversion_used were zeroed as UpdateIC began; home_produced was written by CCountry::CollectDailyProduction just before UpdateIC in RunCountryDailyPass; so of energy and crude oil, usage holds nothing - industry is charged by the shares after the block - and the balance is today's home production with what trade, convoys and tribute have brought or taken. This said 'yesterday's' until then. When convoyed_in, convoyed_out, traded_for, traded_away, income_from_debt, repaid_away and tribute_sent are cleared was not read. rate = CCountry::GetOilConversionRate = 100 + technology_status->oil_conversion_bonus, so 0.1 plus technology. wanted = (pool.energy + energyNet - 2 * (pool.crude_oil + crudeNet)) * 1000 / (1000 + rate * 2000 / 1000) - the energy that, converted, leaves the country holding exactly twice as much energy as crude oil; `1 + 2 x rate` is this divisor and nothing else. per = max(round(1000000 / rate), 1000), the energy one unit of crude oil costs. energy = min(most * per / 1000, wanted, spare); crude = energy * rate / 1000. Then pool.crude_oil += crude, pool.energy -= energy, conversion_used.energy (+0x8F4) += energy and conversion_made.crude_oil (+0x8C8) += crude. **So a country makes at most max(0.05 x TotalIC, 1) crude oil a day, at 1 / rate energy each** - the cap is on the oil made, not the energy spent, and the rate is not `1 + 2 x technology`, both of which FINDINGS-ic.md had. The min and the final rounding go through single-precision floats: (x / 1000.0 + 0.0005) * 1000.0, then 0x401FD0 / 0xC08870.
addresses.revises: comment only: the balance's net flows are the day's so far, not yesterday's - usage zeroed at the head of the day, the conversion pools at UpdateIC's start, home production written just before
addresses.evidence: Disassembled VA 0x4F28B0 (CCountry::ClearDailyPools): writes zero to +0x994..+0x9AC, usage's seven goods (usage +0x98C, goods at +8), then +0xA24.. and on; VA 0x4F0CC0.. (UpdateIC's start): zeroes +0x8E0.. (conversion_used's goods, VA 0x4F0CE4) and +0x8BC.. (conversion_made's goods, VA 0x4F0D36) before the block at 0x4F0FF5. The record's RunDailyPass has ClearDailyPools before RunDailySupplyPass, and RunCountryDailyPass calls CollectDailyProduction (0x4DB434) before UpdateIC (0x4DB442). Measured in OpenHOI3: balancing on today's pools in place of yesterday's usage, Germany1936_01_01_00's crude oil and energy agree for 77 of 77 countries where 69 did (the United States converts 38.25 energy on both days, as the save has it), and the three later start saves' crude oil 72, 69, 69 and energy 71, 64, 62 where 67, 66, 65 and 65, 61, 58 did. Would be shown wrong by a country whose yesterday's industry usage visibly held its conversion back.

addresses.name: CCreateNewHQCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: Slot 6. A CArmy of the command's level and id, the owner's, with one hq_brigade (the next id): home the province, experience UNIT_START_EXPERIENCE x 1000 / 5000 (at most 100%), strength and highest a fifth of its most, **its technologies at nought** - CSubUnit::SetType (VA 0x5E0E11) builds the list at level zero and CSubUnit::ApplyTechnologies (0x5E0F1E, keepStrength false) follows with nothing between that sets a level, so the start saves' new headquarters hold no doctrine where their countries hold several - named by REGIMENT_NAME; placed in the province by CUnit::EnterProvince twice (0x5E0F97 and 0x5E0FAC, CUnit::RebuildAvatar between), **the first of which, its current province null, calls CUnit::CarrySupplies: it brings SUPPLYPOOL_DAYS of what it uses out of its owner's stockpile** - 2.010 supplies for a fifth of an hq_brigade, which every country given one in a new game's first hour has less on the first screen; named (level 0: NAMED_THEATHRE with the theatre's best province, else THEATRE_NAME), its best leader given where the country assigns them, a battle looked for. **At level 0 the theatre stamped on the province, where the owner's, takes it as `unit`, and every unit of the owner of another level flagged an orphan (CUnit +0x50) is attached under it.** See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-theatres.md, section K, and FINDINGS-laterstart.md, section 17.
addresses.revises: comment only: technologies applied at level nought, not the country's; the placing carries its days of supplies out of the stockpile
addresses.evidence: Disassembled VA 0x5E0BB0..0x5E0FC7: 0x5E0E11 `call 0x5ABF30` (CSubUnit::SetType - project.json: builds the technologies list, each at level zero); between it and 0x5E0F1E `push 0; push esi; call 0x5ABFC0` (CSubUnit::ApplyTechnologies) only the home, the experience, two slot-12 strength reads and the clamps - no loop over technologies; then 0x4E06F0 (CCountry::AddUnit), 0x5BE640 (AddRegimentToUnit), 0x4CBFD0 (MakeSubUnitName), 0x5BEFD0, 0x5BDC70, 0x5BEFD0. Measured: Ireland's Dublin HQ brigade made in the first hour holds mass_assault 0 (and every doctrine 0) in Ireland1941_06_22_00 where the country holds 3; and with the carry, 27 more of Germany1936_01_01_00's countries' supplies agree to the thousandth (Ireland 69.506, Denmark 268.885, Latvia 267.186, ...), 16, 17 and 20 more at the three later starts. Would be shown wrong by a new headquarters' brigade holding its country's doctrine levels in a start save.

addresses.name: CCreateHigherCommand::Execute
addresses.comment:
Slot 6. **Makes a headquarters one level above the highest-ranked of its units and puts them under it.**

1. top = the referenced unit with the lowest oob_level (first of equals); none, or top a theatre (level < 1): logged `Failed to create higher command`, nothing.
2. place = top's province; where that is sea, top is land and carried (`CArmy +0x300`), the fleet's home base province (+0x98, slot 0). Still not land: logged `Failed attempt to spawn higher command on the naval base`, nothing.
3. **A CArmy (0x308) of level top - 1**, with the id the constructor reserved (+0x4C/+0x50), the owner top's.
4. **One CRegiment of the hq_brigade type** (CSubUnitDataBase +0x78), id serial + 1, home the place, **strength a twentieth of its most** (x 1000 / 20000, not below 0), its highest raised to that; no experience is given. The owner's Manpower is charged a twentieth of the brigade's men: `(1000 + technology build_cost_mp modifier, at least 50) x build_cost_manpower / 1000 x 1000 / 20000`, held at 0. Named by REGIMENT_NAME (CCountry::MakeSubUnitName), **technologies applied at level nought** (CSubUnit::SetType at VA 0x5DF91E, CSubUnit::ApplyTechnologies at 0x5DFA5A, no level set between - not the country's), the unit added to the country, its avatar made, the brigade added.
5. **Placing it in the order of battle**: where top has a parent - the grandparent instead where the parent is already at the new level - and that one ranks above the new level, the headquarters goes under it; top leaves its parent and goes under the headquarters. Every other referenced unit that CUnit_MayTakeSubordinate lets the headquarters take leaves its parent and goes under it too.
6. Put in the place (CUnit::EnterProvince at VA 0x5DFBE8) - its current province null, so **it brings SUPPLYPOOL_DAYS of what it uses out of its owner's stockpile** (CUnit::CarrySupplies), asked while it is nowhere and so with no commander's reach - its intel level set; **named**: level 0 - CUnit_MakeName with the province, and a new CTheatre (id the game's theatre counter, then raised by one, its `unit` the headquarters) appended to the country's theatres (`CCountry +0x570`); any other level - CUnit_MakeName with no province, `$NUM$$ORDER$ Army Group` / `Army` / `Corps` numbered per country.
7. The best free leader where the country assigns them (`CCountry +0x74B`), CCombatManager::CheckForCombat in top's province, then the creation broadcast (channel 6 for a land unit, with channel 0); for the player, the interface told and, with +0x54, the new unit selected; a custom-game byte set.

The AI never reaches the level-0 arm: CAIUnit_CreateHigherCommands stops at army groups.
addresses.revises: comment only: technologies applied at level nought, not the country's; the placing carries its days of supplies out of the stockpile
addresses.evidence: Disassembled VA 0x5DF600..0x5DFCB7: 0x5DF91E `call 0x5ABF30` (SetType), then only 64-bit arithmetic (0xB99AF0/0xB99980, the strength and the manpower) before 0x5DFA47 MakeSubUnitName and 0x5DFA5A ApplyTechnologies; 0x4E06F0 AddUnit, 0x5BDC70 RebuildAvatar, 0x5BE640 AddRegimentToUnit, the attachments, and `call 0x5BEFD0` at 0x5DFBE8. OpenHOI3 builds both (a test sets one brigade's twentieth carrying 0.75 at one supply a day). Would be shown wrong by a new corps' brigade holding its country's doctrine levels, or a new corps' province gaining nothing.
